propositions: Current clarity measure duplicated across two files rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contract, enabling padded tickets to pass without required sections.

Clarity determinism relies on seven inputs (H2 headings, length thresholds, bullet points, AC checkbox) that do not validate section applicability, AC proof coverage, or placeholder-free scope decisions.

Deterministic checks can be mechanically extended to require nonempty required sections keyed on graph altitude, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, and grounded edit-set without changing existing code architecture.

Author guide and G6 criteria conflict on rejected-alternative prose requirement; until bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 is resolved, clarity must check only nonempty Approach, not alternative rejection wording.

Scoring must replace raw length and any-bullet compensation with named applicable checks returning per-check evidence, derived from satisfied/applicable checks rather than additive points on a fixed scale.
